adr.hit_definition: Next session (high-low)/prior close >= 1.25 × ADR20. Not a 5% close target.

expansion_factor.name: live_rvol
expansion_factor.rule: Volume >= 1.5x 20-day average on the setup day
expansion_factor.note: Backtest (~252 sessions): live_rvol lifts next-session 1.25x-ADR hit rate on all 5 names (HDFC +4.6pp, BAJ +12pp, M&M +17pp, Nifty +25pp n=10, Bank Nifty +12pp). Range expansion helps M&M/Nifty; EMA support and dead volume do not. A 7 is an ADR-expansion call, not a 5% prediction.
